scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @contour/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @contour/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.build: npm run build -w @contour/shared && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.web:dev: npm run build -w @contour/shared && concurrently -k -n backend,frontend "npm run dev -w @contour/web-backend" "npm run dev -w @contour/web-frontend"
scripts.desktop:dev: npm run build -w @contour/shared && npm run build -w @contour/core && npm run build -w @contour/web-backend && npm run build -w @contour/desktop && concurrently -k -n backend,frontend,electron "npm run dev -w @contour/web-backend" "npm run dev -w @contour/web-frontend" "npm run dev -w @contour/desktop"
scripts.desktop:build: npm run build -w @contour/shared && npm run build -w @contour/core && npm run build -w @contour/web-backend && npm run build -w @contour/web-frontend -- --outDir ../../desktop/dist/renderer && npm run dist -w @contour/desktop
